purpose: One bounded offline pair of new actual Darcy typed-reader exports with original mathematical metrics and thresholds. Never launch a solver/build/GenCase, parse BI4 anew, alter raw data, interpolate time, mask fields or reinterpret an old26-column export.

mathematical_basis.scope: Adapt the original pressure RMS, velocity vector RMS, same-ID material displacement vector RMS and maximum vector displacement, Frobenius stress and passive-density descriptive metrics. Constants, scales and half/absolute limits remain unchanged. The old optional weak-continuum diagnostic is omitted; there is no continuum/expm gate.

cli: py tests/support/upl_gpu_darcy_pair_r1.py --pair KIND --a REVIEWDIR --b REVIEWDIR --a-check CHECKJSON --b-check CHECKJSON --out tests/figures/upl_gpu_darcy_actual_KIND_r1

k0_bridge_h.b: retained GPU_legacy_k0_h original raw BI4 re-read by the new Darcy reader

fixed_input_contract.binary: Three little-endian uint32 header values(512,33,257), then257 records of actual double time and512x33 doubles. Exact byte count required; no missing/trailing bytes.
fixed_input_contract.clocks: cadence2^-23, final2^-15; exact time_i=i*cadence. Actual native Step0 initially, otherwise round(time/dt)-1. No native metadata rewrite or time interpolation.
fixed_input_contract.initial_geometry: 32x16, dp1/256, Lx1/8,Lz1/16, x/z half-grid material coordinates, y0. Both old/new k0 actual C++ fixtures truly define33 columns, and the new Darcy reader uses the identical mapping.
fixed_input_contract.pressure_storage: actual float pore pressure/p0/excess, double stored stress, double J/n/theta; no extra PosDiv column in the common33 format.
fixed_input_contract.schemas: CPU has6 native J-derived double arrays and observed actual PosDiv sidecar, public mastertrue/model0/Ck0 metadata. PrivateGPU has3 native double J/n/theta arrays and explicitly derived V/rho/k, no public dynamic metadata and no fabricated PosDiv. New Darcy reader's runtime/model/material/clock verification must be true.

receipt_protocol.check: Require passed backend/model/full257/native512/columns33 matching .check.json; bind all exported files, completion, prepared manifest, actual helper and independent reader-owned exit0 call. Verify exact reader --read MODEL BACKEND DATA DT RUNTIME_XML REVIEWDIR arguments.
receipt_protocol.source_run: Require the bound new .run.json owned_solver_exit0=true, matching selected_input, source native_frames257, solver_completed_before_analysis=true; verify original solver call owned exit0 and program/log. Each exact Part_0000..0256.bi4 file must exist and be in its sealed raw file manifest.
receipt_protocol.retained: For an adopted solve require retained_run_reused=true,new_solver_run=false and bind old_source_run. Do not run old CPU/GPU programs or recursively revalidate old mutable status/current production-source paths.
receipt_protocol.helper: Require actual DarcyActual helper111-object exact link closure and110 GPU substitutions, same bound reader program, author-file hashes and source-build receipt.
receipt_protocol.before_after: Hash all raw native/source/input/program/receipt/export bindings before use and again after offline analysis. JSON stores compact receipts/export bindings; their sealed manifests own the raw257 per-side file hashes.

unchanged_single_native_screens.required: Finite entire33 data/history, exact IDs/actual clocks, original signed dterror<=1e-14 (negative safe values allowed), no exclusions, material positions and actual float excess, elastic/no-load/p0/passive density700..3000.
unchanged_single_native_screens.ledger: Every node/time J>1-n0,|J-1|<=1e-4,0<n<1, n=1-(1-n0)/J,V=V0J,rhot=rhow+(rho0-rhow)/J,relative ledger<=5e-13 and solid-volume residual<=5e-13, exact constant native/derived conductivity.
unchanged_single_native_screens.energy: Recompute the original all-history kinetic+elastic+conditional pore-energy ratio<=1.1. Only telemetry summation comparison uses inherited64DBL_EPS*N*max(1,maxratio). Not exact fluid mass.
unchanged_single_native_screens.time_scales: Same saved coupledCFL<=.01 and positive-k Ddt/h²<=.01 necessary screens; strict positive-k continuous margin>64DBL_EPS*max(rho,rhow). k0 does not use positive-k RH. Full-window natural J evolution>1e-8 required.

all_six_pairs.pressure: At every one of257 exact matched times, sqrt(mean_i((pa-pb)^2))<=5Pa
all_six_pairs.displacement: At every time,1000*max_i(norm(ua-ub))<=.005mm; u is actual same-ID x(t)-x(0).

pair_gates.normalizers: A=2^-9; cu0=sqrt((K+4G/3+Kw/n0)/rho0); Pstar=(Kw/n0)A/cu0; Ustar=A/(cu0*2pi/Lx), fixed no CLI scaling override.
pair_gates.bridge_cross_normalized: Computed and plotted but descriptive only. No old-vs-new complete33 bit equality is imposed; per-column bit-pattern and numeric differences, including signed-zero discrepancies, are explicitly recorded. A half pass never means0ULP.
pair_gates.passive_density: CPU rational vs GPU additive diagnostic density differences are descriptive, not a new exactness guard.

outputs.fresh_prefix_only: .json/.csv/.png; reject any existing suffix. One pair per invocation, no automatic loops across solver actions.
outputs.CSV: Every actual saved time with pair pressure/velocity/material displacement/stress/passive-rho/J/energy metrics and both actual pressure/velocity/material-displacement RMS histories.
outputs.PNG: Lean2x2 actual pressure/material-displacement history and original absolute/normalized error bounds. Log-axis exact zeros have no positive logarithmic ordinate; CSV retains every zero without clipping or smoothing.
outputs.JSON: Full original limits, numeric maxima, receipt provenance, source/derived distinctions and all33 per-column bit/numeric mismatch counts; no false half0ULP placeholder. passed is the declared bounded pair result only.

exclusions: No second BI4 parser or26-to33 conversion
No smoothing/interpolation/relaxed guard or extra damping
No full physical/publicGPU/wall/variable-k/restart/general conservation or continuum1% acceptance
